pages.title: Dokha Tobacco

pages.text: Both varieties dislike shaded cool farms. A location can still grow the crop as long as ordinary crop light requirements are met, but poor biome/light/temperature matches reduce the quality potential of the harvested leaf.
pages.title: Growth vs. Quality
